adasOptional: Data unavailable: EX FWD trim does not offer optional ADAS beyond the standard Honda Sensing 360 suite.

sideViewCameraNotes: No surround-view 360 camera on EX trim (Surround Vision is Elite-only). No Honda LaneWatch passenger-side camera (Prologue uses radar-based blind-spot monitoring instead). Source: https://www.hondainfocenter.com/2026/Prologue/Feature-Guide/Safety-Features/Surround-Vision-System-Elite-Honda-Sensing-feature/
subscriptionFeatures: HondaLink Remote Package ($110/yr after 3-month trial) — remote start, lock/unlock, vehicle locator. HondaLink Security Package — automatic collision notification. HondaLink Concierge Package ($260/yr) — adds reservation services. Google built-in (Google Maps, Google Assistant, Google Play) subscription required after the 8-year trial expires. Heated seats, ADAS, performance are NOT subscription-gated — physical features remain enabled. Source: https://www.jdpower.com/cars/shopping-guides/what-is-hondalink-what-hondalink-plans-are-available
drmNotes: Core driving functions operate without cellular connectivity. HondaLink connected services (remote start, vehicle locator, OTA service-reminder push) require an active subscription and modem signal; lapsed subscription degrades connected features but leaves the car drivable. Google built-in / Google Maps / Google Assistant require subscription after 8-year trial. Source: https://www.jdpower.com/cars/shopping-guides/what-is-hondalink-what-hondalink-plans-are-available
killSwitchNotes: No impaired-driving kill switch installed (MY25 predates the expected MY27 NHTSA mandate). Honda has not announced its compliance approach.
knownIssues: First-year GM-platform software glitches reported on prologuedrivers.com — infotainment freezes, occasional Google Maps disconnects, OTA-update hiccups. No widespread mechanical concerns. Source: https://www.prologuedrivers.com/threads/charging-best-practices-part-2.468/
recalls: Multiple software-related TSBs and a small number of NHTSA recalls during the 2024-2025 production window (shared with the Chevy Blazer EV / Acura ZDX), primarily software / infotainment-related. Source: https://www.nhtsa.gov/vehicle/2025/HONDA/PROLOGUE%20EV/SUV/FWD
stateIncentives: Eligibility varies by state. California: CVRP retired in 2024; Clean Cars 4 All for income-qualified buyers. Colorado: $5,000 state EV tax credit (MY25 still applies). New York: $2,000 Drive Clean Rebate. Note: federal $7,500 credit sunset September 30, 2025 — purchases after that date no longer eligible. Source: https://www.findlayhondahenderson.com/is-honda-prologue-eligible-for-7500-tax-credit/
